llama.description: Start llama-server on :8089 with the default model. Append flags to override, e.g. deno task llama -m ~/models/SmolLM3-Q8_0.gguf

serve.description: Serve docs/ (the site: landing page at /, app at /app.html) on http://localhost:8000 (PORT env overrides), with COOP/COEP headers

dev.description: llama-server and the static server together
dev.command: deno task llama & deno task serve

check.description: Verify the data layer against a running llama-server: deno task check [base-url]

shot.description: Screenshot the app (light and dark) after a run: deno task shot [page-url] [out-dir]; default url http://localhost:8000/app.html?run=1

headless.description: Load a page in headless Chrome and print #out once it starts with DONE or ERROR: deno task headless <url>

model.description: List or download GGUF models into ~/models: deno task model [name|url ...]

pages.description: Serve docs/ exactly as GitHub Pages would: no server engine, no isolation headers (the service worker must provide them)
